name: calendar-respond-to-invite
description: Accept, decline, or tentatively accept an existing calendar invitation as the authenticated principal attendee. Uses Nylas sendRsvp so only the principal's own RSVP status changes and the organizer receives the provider-standard RSVP notification. On accept, optional holdMatchCriteria can release Curia HOLD (TBC) events for the same scheduling conversation.

inputs.calendarId: string (Nylas calendar ID containing the invite)
inputs.eventId: string (Nylas event ID to RSVP to)
inputs.account: string? (named account hint; currently informational because the calendar client is bound to the configured principal grant)
inputs.comment: string? (optional RSVP comment; currently returned as a warning if provided because Nylas sendRsvp only accepts status in this SDK)
inputs.holdMatchCriteria: object? ({ subject?, contactDomain?, contactId?, sourceRef?, threadRef? } used only when response is accept to release matching Curia holds)
inputs.holdSearchStart: timestamp? (start of hold cleanup search window; defaults around the invite time)
inputs.holdSearchEnd: timestamp? (end of hold cleanup search window; defaults around the invite time)

outputs.participantStatus: string (Nylas RSVP status: yes | no | maybe)
outputs.rsvp: object (Nylas RSVP request result, including sendIcsError if present)
outputs.releasedHolds: array (hold event IDs released after accepting)
